# Tulyro

> Free browser-only tools. No signup. No watermark. Nothing you enter is sent to a server.
> Every tool runs entirely in the visitor's browser. Results are informational estimates, not
> professional advice.

## Entity facts

- Name: Tulyro
- Website: https://tulyro.online/
- Contact: Tulyrotools@gmail.com
- Founder & Lead Developer: Sameer Ahmad (GitHub: https://github.com/16sameerahmad)
- Source Code: https://github.com/16sameerahmad/tool-empire (Open Source MIT)
- Trust & Verification: 100% Client-side browser execution. Zero telemetry, zero server-side storage, zero fees, zero account requirements. Inspectable via browser DevTools Network tab.
- Model: free browser-only tools; no accounts, no backend, no database, no watermark, no popups.
- Full detail: https://tulyro.online/llms-full.txt

## Tools

- [GST Calculator (India)](https://tulyro.online/calculators/gst-calculator/): Calculate inclusive and exclusive Goods and Services Tax with the current 0%, 5%, 18% and 40% slabs (plus legacy 12% and 28% for pre-22 September 2025 invoices) and CGST/SGST breakdowns.
- [SWP Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/swp-calculator/): Calculate monthly systematic withdrawal payouts, final corpus balance, and capital exhaustion from mutual funds.
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/lumpsum-calculator/): Compute total maturity value and wealth gains on one-time mutual fund investments using compound interest.
- [CAGR Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/cagr-calculator/): Determine true annualized Compound Annual Growth Rate and total returns across multi-year investments.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/percentage-calculator/): Calculate % of values, proportions, and percentage increase or decrease with step-by-step math.
- [Image Resizer in KB](https://tulyro.online/tools/image-resizer/): Compress and resize photos and signatures to 20KB, 50KB, or 100KB for exam forms. 100% private in-browser.
- [Remove Background](https://tulyro.online/tools/remove-background/): Free client-side image background remover with transparent PNG export. No server upload.
- [SIP Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/sip-calculator/): Mutual fund SIP return calculator with monthly compounding and inflation adjustment.
- [75% Attendance Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/attendance-calculator/): Calculate classes needed to attend or bunk while maintaining university attendance rules.
- [PPF Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/ppf-calculator/): 15-year Public Provident Fund interest, tax-free maturity and balance calculator.
- [SGPA to CGPA Converter](https://tulyro.online/calculators/sgpa-to-cgpa/): Convert semester grade point averages into overall cumulative grade point average.
- [Age Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/age-calculator/): Calculate exact age in years, months and days from a date of birth. See total days lived and the next birthday.
- [EMI Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/emi-calculator/): Estimate a monthly EMI, total interest and total payment for an Indian loan in rupees.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/mortgage-calculator/): Estimate a US mortgage payment with total interest and total payment in dollars.
- [BMI Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/bmi-calculator/): Check adult BMI from height and weight in metric or imperial units, with a switch between WHO global cutoffs and Indian/Asian ICMR cutoffs, plus healthy-weight ranges by height.
- [CGPA to Percentage](https://tulyro.online/calculators/cgpa-to-percentage/): Convert a 10-point CGPA to an estimated percentage using a selectable university formula — CBSE ×9.5, VTU/AKTU/JNTU (CGPA−0.75)×10, GTU (CGPA−0.5)×10, Mumbai 7.1×CGPA+11, or plain CGPA×10 — with division classification. The result is an estimate.
- [Word Counter](https://tulyro.online/text/word-counter/): Count words, characters, sentences and reading time as you type.
- [Text to Speech](https://tulyro.online/text/text-to-speech/): Listen to text read aloud with voices already in the browser. No audio download.
- [Fancy Text Generator](https://tulyro.online/text/fancy-text-generator/): Turn plain text into copyable Unicode styles — bold, italic, script, monospace and more.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://tulyro.online/dev/base64-encoder-decoder/): Encode UTF-8 text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text, entirely in the browser.
- [Invoice Generator](https://tulyro.online/tools/invoice-generator/): Create a simple invoice in the browser and print or save it as PDF. No watermark.
- [Fake Text Generator](https://tulyro.online/fun/fake-text-generator/): Make a generic chat mockup for sketches, presentations and entertainment. Export PNG.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://tulyro.online/tools/json-formatter/): Beautify, minify, and validate JSON data instantly in your browser with byte and character stats.
- [UUID / GUID Generator](https://tulyro.online/tools/uuid-generator/): Generate cryptographically secure RFC 4122 v4 UUIDs in single or batch modes.
- [Case Converter](https://tulyro.online/tools/case-converter/): Convert text between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, and Title Case.
- [Markdown Editor & Live Preview](https://tulyro.online/tools/markdown-editor/): Real-time dual-pane Markdown drafting with instant safe HTML preview and .md export.
- [SGPA Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/sgpa-calculator/): Calculate your semester SGPA from subject credits and letter grades on the 10-point scale, with percentage conversion.
- [Fuel Cost Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/fuel-cost-calculator/): Calculate trip fuel cost from distance, mileage, and fuel price. Supports km/L, L/100km, and mpg, with round-trip and per-person split.
- [Gratuity Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/gratuity-calculator/): Calculate your gratuity payout under the Code on Social Security, 2020 (Section 53), with the 15/26 formula, 6-month rounding, and ₹20 lakh cap.
- [Sleep Calculator](https://tulyro.online/calculators/sleep-calculator/): Find the best bedtime for your wake-up time — or the best time to wake up — using 90-minute sleep cycles.
- [Hash Generator](https://tulyro.online/dev/hash-generator/): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 hashes for text or files entirely in your browser.
- [Image Compressor to 20KB, 50KB, 100KB](https://tulyro.online/tools/image-compressor/): Compress JPG, PNG, WEBP images to exact file sizes (20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB) for UPSC, SSC, NEET, IBPS job forms and KYC portals.
- [PDF to JPG & Image to PDF Converter](https://tulyro.online/tools/pdf-tools/): Convert PDF pages to JPG/PNG images or combine multiple images into a single PDF. 100% browser-based, no upload.
- [JPG to PDF Converter — Convert Images to PDF Online Free](https://tulyro.online/tools/jpg-to-pdf/): Convert JPG and PNG images into a single PDF file online. 100% client-side, private, free, and zero file uploads.
- [PDF to JPG Converter — Extract PDF Pages to High-Quality Images](https://tulyro.online/tools/pdf-to-jpg/): Convert PDF pages to high-resolution JPG or PNG images online. 100% private client-side rendering with zero file uploads.
- [Merge PDF Online Free — Combine Multiple PDF Files](https://tulyro.online/tools/merge-pdf/): Combine multiple PDF files into one document in your browser. 100% private, free, and zero server upload.
- [Compress PDF Online Free — Reduce PDF File Size](https://tulyro.online/tools/compress-pdf/): Compress and reduce PDF file size online to 100KB, 200KB, or 500KB. 100% client-side with zero file uploads.
- [Split PDF Online Free — Extract Pages from PDF](https://tulyro.online/tools/split-pdf/): Extract specific pages or page ranges from PDF files online. 100% private, free, and runs entirely in your browser.
- [JPG to PNG & Image Format Converter Online](https://tulyro.online/tools/image-converter/): Convert JPG to PNG, PNG to JPG, or images to WebP online for free. 100% client-side with zero quality loss.
- [HEIC to JPG Converter — Convert Apple iPhone Photos Online Free](https://tulyro.online/tools/heic-to-jpg/): Convert Apple HEIC and HEIF photos to high-quality JPG or PNG images directly in your browser. 100% private, no file uploads.
- [PDF to Word Converter — Free Online, No Upload, 100% Private](https://tulyro.online/tools/pdf-to-word/): Convert PDF files to editable Word DOCX documents directly in your browser. 100% client-side — zero server uploads, unlimited conversions, completely free.
- [MP4 to MP3 Converter — Extract Audio from Video Online Free](https://tulyro.online/tools/mp4-to-mp3/): Extract high-quality MP3 audio from MP4, MKV, AVI, and MOV videos directly in your browser. Zero uploads, 100% private.
- [JPG to PNG Converter — Free High Quality Online Converter](https://tulyro.online/tools/jpg-to-png/): Convert JPG and JPEG images to lossless PNG format in your browser. Preserves crisp details and transparency support with zero server uploads.
- [PNG to JPG Converter — Convert PNG to JPEG Online Free](https://tulyro.online/tools/png-to-jpg/): Convert PNG images to compact JPG/JPEG format with white background fill. Optimize image size for web and govt applications with 100% privacy.
- [Rotate PDF Online — Permanently Rotate PDF Pages Free](https://tulyro.online/tools/rotate-pdf/): Rotate PDF pages permanently 90 degrees clockwise, counter-clockwise, or 180 degrees flip. 100% client-side with zero file uploads.
- [Image to PDF Converter — Convert Any Image to PDF Online Free](https://tulyro.online/tools/image-to-pdf/): Convert any image (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, SVG, BMP, AVIF) into a single PDF document. 100% client-side, no file uploads, private and free.
- [PDF to Image Converter — Extract PDF Pages to JPG or PNG Online](https://tulyro.online/tools/pdf-to-image/): Convert PDF documents to high-resolution JPG or PNG images online. Completely private browser rendering with zero server uploads.
- [QR Code Generator](https://tulyro.online/tools/qr-code-generator/): Generate customizable QR codes with logo overlay for URLs, text, WiFi, and vCards. Download as PNG or SVG.
- [Barcode Generator](https://tulyro.online/tools/barcode-generator/): Generate Code 39, EAN-13, and UPC-A barcodes in your browser — with check digits, custom sizes, and PNG/SVG download.
- [Income Tax Calculator (India)](https://tulyro.online/calculators/income-tax-calculator/): Compare Old vs New tax regime for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27). Calculate tax liability with deductions under 80C, 80D, HRA and standard deduction.
- [Password Generator](https://tulyro.online/tools/password-generator/): Generate secure, cryptographically random passwords with custom length, numbers, symbols, and strength rating.
- [Epoch & Unix Timestamp Converter](https://tulyro.online/tools/epoch-converter/): Convert a Unix timestamp to date — seconds or milliseconds to human-readable UTC and local date formats. Live clock included.
- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://tulyro.online/dev/json-to-csv-converter/): Convert JSON arrays of objects to CSV instantly — RFC 4180 quoting, delimiter choice, and one-click download.

## Guides

- [How to Calculate EMI by Hand](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-to-calculate-emi/): Worked reducing-balance EMI examples with verified numbers.
- [How to Calculate Your Age in Days](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-to-calculate-age-in-days/): Verified day counts, leap-year handling, and why dividing by 365.25 gives the wrong answer.
- [SWP vs FD for Retirement Income](https://tulyro.online/guides/swp-vs-fd-for-retirement-income/): In-depth comparison of taxation, monthly payouts, and inflation protection between Mutual Fund SWP and Bank FDs.
- [CAGR vs XIRR in Mutual Funds](https://tulyro.online/guides/cagr-vs-xirr-in-mutual-funds/): Understand key differences, formulas, and when to use CAGR vs XIRR.
- [Govt Exam Photo & Signature Size Guide](https://tulyro.online/guides/photo-and-signature-size-guide-for-govt-exams/): SSC, UPSC, and IBPS file size (20KB, 50KB), DPI, and pixel guidelines.
- [CGPA to Percentage: The CBSE ×9.5 Rule, Explained](https://tulyro.online/guides/cgpa-to-percentage-cbse-9-5-rule/): What the ×9.5 rule means, where it applies, and where it does not.
- [EMI Calculator vs Mortgage Calculator: Which One to Use](https://tulyro.online/guides/emi-vs-mortgage-calculator/): Same formula, different currency, formatting, and context — how to pick.
- [How to Choose an EMI Calculator](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-to-choose-emi-calculator/): Five checks that separate honest EMI calculators from traps — total interest, amortization, prepayment, currency, disclosed limits.
- [Calculate Age in Excel](https://tulyro.online/guides/calculate-age-in-excel/): DATEDIF, YEARFRAC and the quick method for exact ages in spreadsheets, with common errors.
- [Is BMI Accurate? What the Number Can't Tell You](https://tulyro.online/guides/is-bmi-accurate/): Where BMI fails (muscle, age, build), what it gets right, and what doctors check instead.
- [How to Calculate BMI: The Formula in Metric and Imperial Units](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-to-calculate-bmi/): The BMI formula worked step by step in metric and imperial units, with common mistakes flagged.
- [How Many Words Fit on a Page?](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-many-words-per-page/): Word counts for single- and double-spaced pages by document type, with margins and font effects.
- [How to Create a GST-Compliant Invoice in India](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-to-create-gst-compliant-invoice-india/): All 16 mandatory fields under CGST Rule 46, CGST/SGST vs IGST splits, and a worked ₹50,000 example.
- [How Mortgage Amortization Works](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-mortgage-amortization-works/): Why most early payments go to interest, a worked $300,000 example, and 15-year vs 30-year comparison.
- [How Much House Can You Afford?](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-much-house-can-you-afford/): The 28/36 rule worked with real numbers for a $120,000 income, salary tables, and rate sensitivity.
- [What Is Base64 Encoding, and When to Use It](https://tulyro.online/guides/what-is-base64-encoding-and-when-to-use-it/): The 24-bit maths behind Base64, why it adds 33% size, padding, and why it is not encryption.
- [How Browser Text-to-Speech Works](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-browser-text-to-speech-web-speech-api-works/): The Web Speech API, optimal listening speeds, and proofreading by ear.
- [How Unicode Fancy Text Works on Social Media](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-unicode-fancy-text-fonts-work-on-social-media/): Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols, style ranges, and accessibility rules.
- [How to Create Chat Mockups for Presentations and UI](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-to-create-chat-mockups-for-presentations-and-ui/): Design specs for crisp chat mockups in Reels, decks, and documentation, with ethical guidelines.
- [SIP vs Lumpsum Investment: Which Generates Better Returns?](https://tulyro.online/guides/sip-vs-lumpsum/): Compare SIP vs Lumpsum investing with exact math, rupee cost averaging breakdowns, market cycle risks, and tax implications. Includes worked examples.
- [The 75% College Attendance Rule: Criteria, Bunk Limits & Medical Condonation](https://tulyro.online/guides/college-75-percent-attendance-rule-explained/): Understand the 75% attendance rule under UGC, AICTE, and university norms. Learn how to calculate bunkable classes, medical condonation, and exam detention rules.
- [EMI vs Flat Rate Interest: How Lenders Hide Real Loan Costs](https://tulyro.online/guides/emi-vs-flat-rate-interest/): Understand reducing balance EMI vs flat rate interest. See worked examples showing why an 8% flat rate is actually a 14.5% reducing balance loan.
- [EMI Prepayment Explained: How Paying Extra Early Saves Lakhs in Interest](https://tulyro.online/guides/emi-prepayment-explained/): Paying ₹5,00,000 extra in year 1 of a ₹50 lakh home loan saves ₹17,69,951 in interest and cuts 50 months off the loan. See the worked math, RBI's no-penalty rule, and when not to prepay.
- [Password Entropy & Strength Guide: What Actually Makes a Password Secure](https://tulyro.online/guides/password-entropy-and-security-guide/): Learn how password entropy works, calculate bits of entropy mathematically, and understand why length outperforms complex character substitution every time.
- [Understanding Unix Epoch Timestamps: Seconds, Milliseconds & Year 2038](https://tulyro.online/guides/unix-epoch-timestamp-guide/): A complete guide to Unix epoch timestamps. Understand how epoch seconds and milliseconds work, detect them in code, and prepare for the Year 2038 Unix rollover.
- [Complete JSON Formatting & Validation Guide: RFC 8259, Errors & Minification](https://tulyro.online/guides/json-formatting-and-validation-guide/): Understand RFC 8259 JSON standards, master beautification and minification, identify line-by-line syntax errors, and optimize payload sizes for web APIs.
- [UUID v4 vs UUID v7: Differences, Database Index Performance & Which to Choose](https://tulyro.online/guides/uuid-v4-vs-v7-which-should-you-use/): Compare UUID v4 and UUID v7: learn how random v4 causes B-Tree index fragmentation and why time-ordered v7 solves PostgreSQL, MySQL and distributed database bottlenecks.
- [Code Naming Conventions Explained: camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case & kebab-case](https://tulyro.online/guides/code-naming-conventions-camelcase-snake-case/): Master programming naming styles across JavaScript, Python, Rust, Go, CSS, and SQL. Understand why different languages enforce specific casing standards.
- [Complete Markdown Cheatsheet: Syntax, Formatting Rules & Safe Web Publishing](https://tulyro.online/guides/markdown-cheatsheet-and-formatting-guide/): A complete guide to Markdown formatting. Learn CommonMark and GFM syntax for headers, code blocks, lists, blockquotes, tables, and preventing XSS when compiling to HTML.
- [Text-to-Speech Voices Explained: How They're Made and How to Choose One](https://tulyro.online/guides/text-to-speech-voices-guide/): How TTS voices are made (formant, concatenative, neural), the five factors that decide voice quality, verified narration-time estimates, and a practical voice-selection checklist.
- [How to Calculate Percentage: The Three Formulas That Cover Every Case](https://tulyro.online/guides/how-to-calculate-percentage/): Three percentage formulas cover every case: find the part, find the percent, find the whole. Worked examples: 25% of 200 is 50, 15% off ₹1,200, a 15% pay rise.
- [All Guides](https://tulyro.online/guides/): Index of every guide.
